zh-CN.Plywood vs solid wood for shelves: which: 围绕“Plywood vs Solid Wood for Shelves: Sag, Cost, and Span”的实用流程，帮助个人木工和小型工坊在购买板材前看清零件、排版、余料和切割顺序。
zh-CN.The number one shelf problem is sag, a s: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.Plywood's cross-laminated layers give it: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.Solid wood shelves are beautiful and tra: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.Whatever the material, the span between: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Plywood needs its edge treated, banding: Plywood needs its edge treated, banding or a solid-wood lip, to hide the layered core and stiffen the front edge. A solid-wood front lip on a plywood shelf both finishes the look and adds significant sag resistance. Solid wood needs no edge treatment but does need finishing to manage movement. The edge detail is part of the material decision.
zh-CN.Whether plywood or solid wood, the shelf: Whether plywood or solid wood, the shelf parts, the shelves, supports, and any edge lips, are a small cut list. A cut list tool lets you plan the shelf and supports together and, for plywood, lay the shelves out efficiently on a sheet. The CutList app handles the plywood layout and keeps the parts organized so the shelves come out consistent.
确认所有零件名称和数量。
zh-CN.Use plywood for long, load-bearing shelv: 设置真实板材尺寸与锯缝。
zh-CN.Use solid wood for short, visible shelve: 检查纹理方向和可见面。
zh-CN.Set support spacing to the load to contr: 保存或导出最终切割方案。
zh-CN.Treat the plywood edge with banding or a: Treat the plywood edge with banding or a solid lip.
